notes.title: Don Bradman Cricket 17 Steam Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Batting and bowling feedback HUD improved
Weather variation improved
Fielder responsiveness improved
Statistics tracking and display in Career, Competition and Tour modes improved
Shot selection relative to AI bowling variation improved
Stamina system improved
Adjustments to AI shot selection
Adjustments to AI bowler selection
Adjustments to edge frequency
Adjusted colour of ball length markers
Added deduplication to downloaded logos
Added help text to Gameplay Sliders screen
Added opposing bowler/batsman strengths/weaknesses HUD to L3/LS
Added option to hide selected fielder HUD
Prevented stadium advertising from changing during delivery
Resolved issues where statistics would be recorded incorrectly in career
Resolved issue where changes made to field placements wouldn't stick
Resolved issue where competition standings would be incorrect
Resolved issue with tournament progression Resolved issue where Spin RPM would not display
General stability improvements
 
NOTE: This is an interim build, updates will be released on a daily basis for the next few days.
NOTE: Online has been optimised however there are still issues that will be resolved over the next few days.
NOTE: Console patches are to be released once approved by the respective platform holders.
